office_does: A Spokane County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Richard M. Leland is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Spokane County District Court judge since 2013; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Statement stresses public safety, a voice for crime victims and careful spending of court dollars [S1]
